name: io.github.Servosity/quickbooks-mcp
title: QuickBooks Online MCP
description: Every QuickBooks Online Accounting entity, plus an offline SQLite mirror and AR/AP aging.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 bearer access token (scope com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting). Mint it from the Intuit OAuth 2.0 Playground or `quickbooks-cli auth refresh`.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full company-scoped API base, e.g. https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/<realm-id>. Leave blank when you set the realm ID and environment above; the CLI builds this from them.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Intuit app (developer.intuit.com > your app > Keys). Set it with the client secret and refresh token so the CLI can mint a fresh access token; leave blank if you paste an access token instead.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Which Intuit host the realm lives on: production or sandbox. Combined with the realm ID to build the base URL.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID
environmentVariables.description: The QuickBooks company ('realm') ID every call is scoped to. Find it in the Intuit developer dashboard or the sandbox company URL. Without it the CLI cannot build a working base URL.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token. Refresh tokens live ~100 days and rotate on every refresh, so the CLI writes the new one back to its config.

environmentVariables.name: QUICKBOOKS_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.
